title: Fibre and intersection refinement of a spread model
statement: The refinement assertion used in the proof of lem-sbc-geometric-generic-cover-model, assuming an étale model with closed cover data.

proof.text: This is the corresponding construction step in the cited Stacks argument; the theorem is isolated as a strict intermediate assertion so the main theorem combines two independent parts.

lean.statement: theorem refine_geometric_generic_cover_model_data {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace S] (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] {L : Type u} [Field L] (yη : Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (S.residueField (genericPoint S)))) [IsFinite yη] [Etale yη] {I : Type u} [Finite I] (A : I → Set ↥(pullback (f.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)) yη)) (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (A i)) (hcover : (⋃ i, A i) = Set.univ) (hgeom : ∀ i, ∀ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (z : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)), IsIrreducible ((pullback.fst (pullback.snd (f.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)) yη) z) ⁻¹' A i)) {T : Scheme.{u}} {g : T ⟶ S} {η : T} {C : I → Set ↥(pullback f g)} (hg : Etale g) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) (hgη : g η = genericPoint S) (hCclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (C i)) (hCcover : (⋃ i, C i) = Set.univ) : (∀ i t, ∀ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (z : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (T.residueField t))), IsIrreducible ((pullback.fst ((pullback.snd f g).fiberToSpecResidueField t) z ≫ (pullback.snd f g).fiberι t) ⁻¹' C i)) ∧ ∀ i j, (A i ∩ A j).Nonempty → (C i ∩ C j ∩ (pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹' {η}).Nonempty
